document.abstract: This document contains naming guidelines for metadata item names and symbols in the SMPTE family of metadata registers that follow the provisions of SMPTE ST 336. A metadata item may be an entry in the Elements, Labels, Groups, Types, or other registers. These naming standards have been developed to aid consistency and precision, and prevent unnecessary redundancy. — This document contains semantic, syntactic, and lexical guidelines relating to the naming of items in SMPTE metadata registers. — This document contains an annex of preferred terminology that will be updated as required.
